caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned lantern centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The lantern is rendered in shades of graphite gray and black, showing detailed textures and shading. It has a round base and a cylindrical central body with vent holes at its lower and upper sections. Four curved wire guards surround the glass chamber of the lantern, providing structural protection. The top of the lantern has a conical, vented cap, also with vent holes, and a large, curved carrying handle extends from opposite sides of the top, arching above the lantern. The glass chamber within the wire frame reflects light subtly, and all other surfaces are colored in various gray tones, consistent with metallic and glass materials. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, the artist's signature "F. STRÖM" is visible. The entire composition is centered and isolated against the otherwise empty background.
title: Hand Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
